entities.summary: Drenas or Gllogovc/Gllogoc, or Glogovac, is a town and municipality in the district of Pristina, Kosovo. The municipality has an area of 276.63 km2 (106.81 sq mi). According to the last census of 2024, the municipality has a population of 48,079.
